definition: An attack where the user is trusted but Claude processes third-party content (web pages, emails, documents, tool results) with adversarial instructions.
whyItMatters: The attacker isn't your user (unlike a jailbreak). Put untrusted content only in `tool_result` blocks, label its source, JSON-encode it, use least privilege.
example: An email saying "Ignore previous instructions…" is JSON-encoded in a `tool_result` so it reads as data, not a directive.
